name: Bot Detection - PingOne Protect
comment: Bot Detection is a PingOne Protect predictor (type BOT) requiring the PingOne Protect license and the PingOne Signals (Protect) SDK. PingGateway reacts at risk-level granularity only: the evaluation response's details.botDetection attributes (level, type, reason, detected.rule.id) and the result.recommendedAction BOT_MITIGATION value are consumed by the PingOne risk policy, which produces the risk level routed by this route.

heap.name: SystemAndEnvSecretStore-1
heap.comment: Retrieves the PingOne worker application client secret from the environment: export the client secret base64-encoded as the CLIENT_SECRET_ID environment variable; this store exposes it under the secret id client.secret.id.

heap.name: ClientCredentialsOAuth2ClientFilter-1
heap.comment: Obtains PingOne access tokens with the worker application client credentials (client credentials grant) for requests made through the PingOneService.

heap.name: RiskEndpointHandler
heap.comment: Endpoint handler used by the PingOneService to call the PingOne service endpoints with the worker application access token.

heap.name: PingOneService-1
heap.comment: PingOne environment service endpoint; PingGateway derives the risk evaluation and feedback endpoints from it.

heap.name: StepUpHandler
heap.comment: Step-up authorization for medium-risk requests; the feedback filter registers the success of the post-evaluation actions with PingOne Protect and resets the assumed risk level to low.

heap.name: FailureHandler
heap.comment: Denies high-risk requests with HTTP 403; the feedback filter registers the failure of the post-evaluation actions with PingOne Protect.

filters.name: CrossDomainSingleSignOnFilter-1
filters.comment: CDSSO authentication against the AM instance; the authenticated user (subname claim) is passed to the PingOneProtectEvaluationFilter as the evaluation userId.

filters.name: PingOneProtectEvaluationFilter-1
filters.comment: Evaluates the session risk with PingOne Protect and records the risk level in the PingOneProtectEvaluationContext. The deviceProfile callbackEndpoint must match the route condition, and admin.json must set the connectors maxTotalHeadersSize to 32768 to avoid HTTP 431 errors caused by device profile cookies.
